headline: Google careers posting seeks RNM and AMS verification expertise for high-speed PHY work
fact: A Google careers posting for a senior verification engineer in Israel lists ownership of verification for 112G and 224G high-speed PHY signal-processing designs. The role includes real-number-model or SystemVerilog-AMS flows across analog-front-end and DSP boundaries and verification of adaptive-algorithm stability, tracking, and process-voltage-temperature behavior. This is evidence of a public hiring requirement, not proof of a deployed internal methodology.

sources.title: Senior Verification Engineer, Digital Signal Processing, Google Cloud
sources.summary: Google's careers page lists the high-speed-PHY scope, RNM or SystemVerilog-AMS experience, AFE-to-DSP verification, adaptive algorithms, and Israel locations.
